title: Role-play lab: six IDCW conversations
objectives: Answer six IDCW client conversations on control, predictability and tax.
Use the module's scenario answers (Q21–Q25) as trainer-marked practice.
body_md:
In pairs. One person plays the client, the other explains — in plain words, with a rupee example.

| Client says | Explain |
| --- | --- |
| “I want the dividend option; it's extra income.” | Explain what IDCW really is, using the NAV example: own money paid back, NAV falls, taxed at slab. |
| A retiree wants ₹25,000 a month from ₹50 lakh. | Compare IDCW payout with an SWP on control, predictability and tax. |
| “My monthly IDCW was cut this month. Is the fund in trouble?” | Explain why payouts aren't guaranteed and what to review: total return, not payouts. |
| A client has been in IDCW reinvestment for 8 years. | Explain the tax impact and discuss switching to growth, including switching costs. |
| “The fund declares IDCW next week. Should I buy now?” | Explain why buying before the record date doesn't help: NAV falls, tax is due. |
| “Why was TDS deducted from my IDCW?” | Explain TDS, the threshold, and how it's adjusted in the tax return. |

> **Investor takeaway:** Quiz scenarios Q21–Q25 (trainer-marked): a scenario answer earns its mark if it covers at least three model points and makes no promise of returns.
example: Role-play the retiree: ₹25,000 by IDCW (trustee decides, whole payout taxed) vs ₹25,000 by SWP (you decide, only gain taxed).
say: IDCW doesn't create money; it moves money.
Record why the client chose IDCW, if they do.
never: Suggest buying before a record date to “earn” the payout.

check.q: A client says, “I want the dividend option; it’s extra income.” How do you respond?
o: Agree — IDCW is a bonus on top of returns
Explain IDCW with the NAV example: own money paid back, NAV falls by the payout, taxed at slab; compare SWP or growth
Recommend buying before the next record date
check.why: Explains IDCW with the NAV example; own money paid back; taxed at slab; compares SWP or growth.

check.q: A retiree wants ₹25,000 a month from ₹50 lakh. IDCW or SWP?
o: IDCW payout, because it feels like income
SWP from growth generally: compare control, predictability and tax; check sustainability; tax via CA
check.why: Compares control, predictability and tax; recommends SWP from growth generally; checks sustainability; tax via CA.

check.q: A client’s monthly IDCW was cut. “Is the fund in trouble?” How do you respond?
o: Yes — a cut always means trouble
Payouts aren’t guaranteed and depend on surplus; review the fund on total return, not payouts
Promise the payout will return next month
check.why: Explains payouts aren't guaranteed and depend on surplus; reviews fund on total return, not payouts.
